fields.title: Proteomic analysis of C2C12 myoblasts treated with Tunicamycin
fields.description: Label free proteomic analysis of C2C12 myoblasts treated with either Tunicamycin (0.2ug/ml) alone or with PERK AMG44 (2uM) for 8h and followed by 16h recovery.
fields.keywords: Tunicamycin, ER stress,skeletal muscle,  PERK AMG44
fields.reference_titles: Adaptive ER stress promotes mitochondrial remodelling and longevity through PERK-dependent MERCS assembly
